modelDesc.animevideov3: Lightweight anime/video upscaler. Fastest option; good for animation frames and clean line art, weaker on fine detail.
modelDesc.generalX4v3: Compact general-purpose 4x model. Balanced speed and quality; a solid everyday default.
modelDesc.x2plus: General-purpose 2x model (RRDB). Best for a natural, artifact-free moderate upscale.
modelDesc.x4plus: High-quality general-purpose 4x model. Strong on real-world photos and textures; slower due to its size.
modelDesc.x4plusAnime: 6-block anime model. Preserves clean edges and flat colors; ideal for illustrations and line art.
modelDesc.anime4b: Very small anime model (4 blocks). Fast and light; use when speed matters more than fine detail.
modelDesc.swinirM: Transformer-based model focused on pixel fidelity. Excellent for compressed or degraded photos; large and slow.
modelDesc.swinirL: Largest SwinIR variant with the highest reconstruction fidelity. Best quality, slowest and heaviest.
modelDesc.swin2srLight: Lightweight Swin2SR 2x model. Fast general-purpose upscaling with modest resource use.
modelDesc.swin2srClassicalX2: Swin2SR 2x model trained for classical bicubic degradation. Great for clean, downscaled images.
modelDesc.swin2srClassicalX4: Swin2SR 4x model for classical degradation. High fidelity on clean images at larger magnification.
modelDesc.swin2srRealworldX4: Swin2SR 4x model tuned for real-world/BSRGAN degradation. Good for noisy or compressed photos.
modelDesc.swin2srCompressedX4: Swin2SR 4x model for heavily compressed images (JPEG). Recovers detail while suppressing blocking.
modelDesc.realcugan2x: Real-CUGAN 2x model for anime. Strong line preservation and denoising on illustrations.
modelDesc.esrganX4: Classic ESRGAN 4x model. Rich texture synthesis; may over-sharpen on real photos.
